cards.title: Core idea
cards.body: A design pattern is a named, reusable solution to a recurring object-oriented design problem: a description of how to arrange classes and objects, not code to copy. The 23 classic patterns come from the 1994 Gang of Four book.

cards.title: How it works
cards.body: Three groups: creational (Factory, Builder) control object creation; structural (Adapter, Decorator, Facade) control composition; behavioral (Strategy, Observer, Command) control interaction. Their value is proven trade-offs and shared vocabulary. Adapter converts one interface to another clients expect.

questions.q: Is Singleton a good default for a database connection?
questions.a: Usually not. It is global mutable state that hides dependencies and makes unit tests hard.
Converts a class's interface into another interface clients expect.
